question: For each spelling of an MCP grant in a Claude subagent's `tools` field, which MCP tools does the subagent's model request carry, directly or as deferred, and does `ToolSearch` come with them?

assertion.projection: def governed: [.[] | select(.system | tostring | contains("AGENTSPEC-PROBE-MARKER-CCMCP4T"))]; def shape: {direct: ([.[] | .tools[]?.name | select(startswith("mcp__"))] | unique), deferred: ([.[] | .. | strings | select(contains("The following deferred tools are now available via ToolSearch")) | split("\n")[] | select(startswith("mcp__"))] | unique), tool_search: any(.[]; any(.tools[]?; .name == "ToolSearch"))}; with_entries(.value |= (governed | if length == 0 then "arm-had-no-governed-request" else shape end))
